about.title: About us
about.lede: YĒKORA is a Mexican store specializing in gear, clothing and accessories for outdoor activities.

sections.title: Who we are
paragraphs: We started with a clear idea: bring the outdoors closer to more people, with functional products, trusted brands and options for different needs and budgets.

We believe enjoying nature should not depend on owning the most expensive gear, but we also know quality, function and safety matter. That is why we bring together Mexican and international brands, with a special focus on supporting Mexican makers.
From a first hike to a technical expedition, we want everyone to find the right gear for their path.

sections.title: Our purpose
paragraphs: Help more people live outdoor experiences with the right gear, the information they need and the confidence to start or continue their own route. We don't just want to sell products: we want to make experiences possible.

sections.title: Mission
paragraphs: Offer a reliable and accessible selection of outdoor gear, combining quality, function and advice so everyone can choose according to their activity, experience and budget.
Support Mexican brands and bring specialized products both to beginners and to people building their skills in the mountains and other natural settings.

sections.title: Vision
paragraphs: Become a Mexican outdoor store known for trust, variety and knowledge of the gear it sells, with physical and online stores that bring Mexican and international brands to a growing community that enjoys hiking, mountaineering, climbing, canyoning, trail running and other outdoor activities.
Grow responsibly, keeping our identity, our closeness to customers and our commitment to a respectful relationship with nature.

values.title: Accessibility
values.text: There are many ways to start an adventure. We offer options for different budgets without losing sight of quality and function.

values.title: Trust
values.text: We want you to know what you are buying, what each product is for and what its limits are.

values.title: Love for nature
values.text: The outdoors inspires us. We promote a mindful and respectful practice of outdoor activities.

values.title: Supporting Mexican talent
values.text: We value Mexican talent, design and manufacturing, and make room for Mexican brands that deserve more visibility.

values.title: Learning and community
values.text: There is always something new to learn. We listen to people of every experience level and share useful knowledge.

about.promise: The right gear. Clear information. Options for every stage of your adventure. We don't claim the most expensive product is always the best choice: we help you find what you really need.
personality: Approachable: we speak plainly, without elitism or unnecessary jargon.
Reliable: we explain what a product really does rather than overstate its benefits.
Adventurous: we love discovering new places, disciplines and experiences.
Practical: good gear has to meet a real need.
Authentic: our identity comes from the Mexican outdoors.
about.closing: YĒKORA doesn't want everyone to buy more gear. It wants to help everyone buy better.

privacy.title: Privacy notice and personal data handling

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: The controller of your personal data is Ana Karen Flores Baca, located at Av. Barones 209, Las Américas, 98612 Guadalupe, Zacatecas, Mexico (phone +52 492 942 1780, email contacto@yekora.mx), under Mexico's Federal Law on Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties published in the Official Gazette on March 20, 2025.

sections.title: Personal data we handle
paragraphs: If you buy on the site, we ask for your full name, email, phone and delivery address, and for your express consent with a checkbox before paying. We do not ask for sensitive data. You enter your card or account details directly on the Stripe or Mercado Pago page, and they never reach YĒKORA.

When you browse, your browser sends technical data (such as your IP address and browser type) that the hosting server logs for security. We also use a single first-party technical cookie, described in the Cookie policy.

sections.title: Purposes
paragraphs: Primary purposes, needed for our relationship with you: process, charge and deliver your order; contact you about it; handle exchanges, returns and warranties; meet legal and tax obligations; show you the content in the language of the page you visit; remember that you read the cookie notice; keep the products you add to your pack in your browser, and protect the site against misuse.
Secondary purposes: none. We do not use your data for advertising, commercial profiling or analytics.

sections.title: Transfers
paragraphs: To charge your order we use the payment processor you choose: Stripe for cards and cash at OXXO, and Mercado Pago for SPEI transfers and Mercado Pago balance. We only send them the order number and the amount; what you enter on their page is handled under their own privacy notices.

To deliver your order we share only your name, phone and delivery address with the courier company. The site's hosting provider acts as a processor and handles data on behalf of the controller. Beyond these cases we do not transfer your personal data to third parties.

sections.title: Security and retention
paragraphs: We store your name, email, phone and address encrypted (AES-256-GCM) in our database, with keys used only for that purpose. To find your orders we use a cryptographic fingerprint of your email, not the readable email.
We keep each order's data for as long as needed to fulfill it, handle warranties and returns and meet our legal and tax obligations; after that we delete it.

sections.title: ARCO rights and withdrawal of consent
paragraphs: You can exercise your rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation and Opposition, withdraw your consent or limit the use of your data by sending a request to contacto@yekora.mx.

Your request must include your name, a way to reply to you, a document proving your identity or that of your representative, and a clear description of the data and the right you want to exercise. We will reply within the time limits set by law.

sections.title: Cookies
paragraphs: The site only uses first-party technical cookies. We use no third-party, advertising or analytics cookies. Details are in the Cookie policy.
We also keep a technical copy of the site files in your browser (Cache Storage) so it works offline. It holds no personal data.

If you add products to your pack, we keep in your browser (local storage, «yekora_cart_v1») only the code of each product and its quantity. It is not a cookie, holds no personal data and is never sent to third parties; the details are in the Cookie policy. If you choose your state to calculate shipping, we also keep («yekora_shipping_state_v1») only the code of that state; never your postal code or your address.

When you start a payment, we keep in that browser tab (session storage, «yekora_order_access_v1») the order number, an access key to its status and the link to the payment page, so we can show you how your order is doing when you come back. It holds none of your contact or payment details and is erased when you close the tab.

sections.title: Changes to this notice
paragraphs: When this notice changes, we will publish the new version on this page with its update date.

sections.title: What cookies are
paragraphs: Cookies are small files a website stores in your browser to remember information between visits.

sections.title: Cookies we use
paragraphs: We only use first-party technical cookies, needed for the site to work as you expect. We use no analytics, advertising or third-party cookies.

sections.title: Your pack (cart)
paragraphs: If you add products to your pack, the site keeps in your browser, in local storage under the name «yekora_cart_v1», only the code of each product and the quantity you chose, so it is still there on your next visit.

It is not a cookie, holds no personal data, is not used to track you and is never sent to third parties. Prices and stock are always checked on our server. It is erased when you empty your pack, or from the site data in your browser.

If you choose your delivery state to calculate shipping, the site also keeps, under the name «yekora_shipping_state_v1», only the code of that state (for example, ZAC), to remember it between visits. It never keeps your postal code or your address. It is deleted when you clear the state in your pack or from the site data in your browser.

sections.title: Your order
paragraphs: When you start a payment, the site keeps in that browser tab, in session storage under the name «yekora_order_access_v1», your order number, an access key to its status and the link to the payment page, so it can show you how your order is doing when you come back from the processor.
It is not a cookie, holds none of your contact or payment details and is never sent to third parties: the key only travels to our server to check your order. It is erased when you close the tab.

sections.title: Local storage for offline use
paragraphs: Besides the technical cookie, the site keeps a copy of its files in your browser (Cache Storage, through a service worker) so it loads faster and shows the pages you already visited when you are offline.
That copy holds no personal data, is not used to track you, and is renewed automatically with each version of the site. You can delete it from your browser settings, under site data.

sections.title: How to turn them off
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies in your browser settings. The site will keep working, but it will show the cookie notice again.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If we use other cookies in the future, we will update this policy and ask for your consent where the law requires it, before turning them on.

sections.title: Purpose
paragraphs: These terms govern the use of yekora.mx, operated by Ana Karen Flores Baca. By using the site you accept these terms.

sections.title: Site use policy
paragraphs: You may browse the content for personal and informational purposes. You may not use the site for unlawful activities, try to access its systems without authorization, disrupt how it works or copy its content for commercial purposes without permission.

sections.title: Trademarks and intellectual property
paragraphs: The YĒKORA brand, its logo, its isotype and the site's content are protected under Mexican law. Third-party brands shown belong to their owners.

sections.title: Product information and prices
paragraphs: We describe products with clear information about their uses and limits. Under Mexico's Federal Consumer Protection Law, prices are stated in Mexican pesos (MXN) and include the total amount to pay. In the English version, the US dollar price will only be a reference and the peso price will remain visible.

sections.title: Online purchases
paragraphs: You can buy as a guest, without creating an account. Before paying you see each product's price with VAT included, the shipping cost to your state and the total in Mexican pesos (MXN). The total is calculated on our server and is the amount you pay.

Payment methods: credit or debit card and cash at OXXO, processed by Stripe; SPEI bank transfer and Mercado Pago balance, processed by Mercado Pago. You pay on the processor's secure page; YĒKORA never receives or stores your card details.

When you start the payment we hold your items according to the method: 60 minutes with a card or Mercado Pago balance, 24 hours with SPEI and 72 hours with OXXO. Your order is confirmed when the processor confirms the payment; if the time runs out without payment, the order expires and the items are released without any charge.

If a payment arrives after the order expired, we review it and contact you to either deliver the order or refund you. Shipping, exchange, return and warranty terms are on the Shipping and returns page, in line with chapter VIII Bis of the Federal Consumer Protection Law and standard NMX-COE-001-SCFI-2018.

sections.title: Consumer rights
paragraphs: Your consumer rights are protected by Mexico's Federal Consumer Protection Law. You can contact the Federal Consumer Protection Agency (PROFECO) with any complaint.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the federal laws of the United Mexican States. For their interpretation and enforcement, the parties submit to the competent courts of Guadalupe, Zacatecas, Mexico.

sections.title: Coverage and delivery times
paragraphs: We ship anywhere in Mexico through national courier services.
The shipping cost and estimated delivery time are calculated and shown to you before you confirm your purchase.

sections.title: Return window
paragraphs: You have 30 calendar days from delivery to return a product.
Send it back in the same condition you received it, with its accessories and packaging.

sections.title: Return shipping cost
paragraphs: If the product arrived damaged, defective or is not the one you ordered, YĒKORA covers the return shipping and sends you a prepaid label.
If you return it because you changed your mind, your preference or your size, the return shipping is on you.

sections.title: Refunds
paragraphs: We refund you within 10 business days after we receive the return, to the same payment method you used.

sections.title: Warranties
paragraphs: Products carry their manufacturer's official warranty. YĒKORA guides you and handles the claim at no extra cost.

sections.title: How to start a return or a claim
paragraphs: Write to contacto@yekora.mx or call +52 492 942 1780 with your order number and the reason. We will reply with the next steps.
Your rights as a consumer are protected by the Mexican Federal Consumer Protection Law. You can turn to PROFECO, the Federal Consumer Protection Agency, for any claim.
